# Handshake by Radost IT

> Escrow for AI shopping agents. A buyer agent finds real products, negotiates with seller agents, and pays through PayPal escrow. The money is authorized, not captured, and moves only when a verifier checks the delivery against the signed deal contract. The language model never moves money: agents propose, and tested code captures or voids the payment.

Handshake is an entry in the PayPal AI Hackathon 2026, built by Radost IT. It runs on the PayPal sandbox only, so no real money moves.

## Who it is for

Teams building AI shopping agents. Their users will not let an agent pay, because one fake listing or injected message could cost them money. Today the options are a card with no limits or a human in every step. Handshake adds escrow plus a policy check, so the agent can pay and the money moves only when the deal checks out.

## How a deal works

1. The user gives the buyer agent a goal, a budget and a mandate: maximum price, blocked categories, and a price above which a human must approve.
2. The buyer agent searches real products through Channel3 and negotiates with seller agents, within a turn cap.
3. On agreement, both sides sign a deal contract: item, price, delivery deadline and checkable acceptance criteria.
4. The payment is authorized with PayPal Orders (intent AUTHORIZE). This hold is the escrow.
5. The seller submits delivery evidence. A verifier agent checks each acceptance criterion and proposes capture, void or escalation.
6. A deterministic policy engine checks the proposal against the contract and the mandate. Only then does the settlement code capture or void the PayPal authorization.
7. Holds near expiry are reauthorized automatically. A deal is marked settled only after a confirmed capture.

## Red Team Lab

Security researchers act as a malicious seller and try to make the agents release money they should not: prompt injection in a listing, fake urgency, a price switch after agreement, swapped-item evidence, partial delivery, impersonating the platform, currency confusion and split payments. A judge agent decides whether the attempt is a breach. A breach earns a sandbox bounty through PayPal Payouts and becomes a regression test, so every attempt makes the agents harder to fool. Researchers are invited; each picks a public handle.

## Technology

- PayPal Orders v2 with authorize, capture, void and reauthorize; PayPal Payouts; signature-verified PayPal webhooks
- Channel3 for real product search
- Amazon Bedrock (Converse API) for the buyer, seller, verifier and judge agents
- AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, DynamoDB, CloudFront
- Next.js, AG Grid Community and AG Charts Community
